title: Smoked Tofu Curry
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegan curry made with smoked tofu, hot spices, and aromatic Vietnamese flavors. Serve over steamed rice or noodles for a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add tofu and cook until browned on all sides, about 3-4 minutes.
Add coconut milk, fish-free sauce, and salt. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Stir in Thai basil and serve over steamed rice or noodles.
